tasks.gr8-brochures-visual-literacy-t1: Topic: Brochures and visual literacy. Cover brochure format, audience, purpose, layout choices, skimming, scanning, and inference from visual and verbal clues. Ask Grade 8 learners to identify brochure features, match text design to audience needs, choose appropriate reading strategies, and justify inferences from short brochure extracts.
tasks.gr8-poetry-close-reading-t1: Topic: Poetry and close reading. Cover stanza structure, rhyme, imagery, tone, theme, and line-reference interpretation. Ask Grade 8 learners to analyse language choices, identify poetic devices, track tone shifts, and support answers with evidence from lines in short poem extracts.
tasks.gr8-language-structures-bias-t1: Topic: Language structures and bias. Cover nouns, adjectives, verbs, adverbs, tense control, punctuation, and the concepts of bias, prejudice, and stereotypes in texts. Ask Grade 8 learners to solve grammar-in-context items, edit sentence errors, identify loaded language, and choose fair evidence-based wording.
